_source: MOSPI (Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation) / RBI published annual CPI (Combined) inflation figures, financial-year basis. Used to block-bootstrap plausible future inflation paths from actual historical prints, replacing the hardcoded regime-tied Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process previously used.
_note: This is real historical data, not a market-assumption formula. Extend this file as new financial years' data is published.
